evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this might take ten to fifteen minutes of your time' but does NOT frame it as 'you can walk away with a quote you can depend on' and does NOT ask for explicit agreement before continuing. Customer simply acknowledges 'That's fine. Not a problem.'
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Carol Kilar), moving day (Wednesday October 7th, flexible any day but Tuesday), route (from Archeru Texas to Liberty Hill Texas — city to city), approximate size (400 sq ft current, 1230 sq ft destination) — all four present.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer explicitly states 'Not at all' when asked about concerns, so no concerns were raised to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised, so no reflection opportunity existed.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (tiny home / regular home), stories (one story each, with loft in current), bedrooms (1), parking (can park in front / driveway available), special considerations (generator fuel-disconnected, patio tables with glass top, mattresses), items detailed with dimensions. Seven categories substantially covered.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Range given: '$480 to $672' with typical 2.5 to 3.5 hour estimate based on distance and item count; personalized to 'one story to one story house but the drive time in between the location could be between thirty minutes to an hour.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee / overnight fee not mentioned. Stated: '$192 per hour for two movers' with 'no hidden fees of any type, no credit card fees, no terrible fees, no disassemble or reassemble fee, no transportation fees.' Stated: '2 and a half hour minimum' and 'time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.' Both elements present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly to booking after estimate: 'So with that, would you like to be on the schedule for, let's say Wednesday October 7th, or we also have Monday available like tomorrow, if you want to do it tomorrow?' No 'Does that feel fair?' and no pause for customer reflection.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned. No reference to discounting if late or any timeliness guarantee.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Never mentioned. No reference to $2,000 coverage, no-deductible framing, or built-in protection.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Not applicable — neither promise was delivered, so no loop to close.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Alright. Do you have any more questions before I let you go?' — this is a standard throwaway 'any questions' format, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' was presented.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep says 'So with that, would you like to be on the schedule for, let's say Wednesday October 7th, or we also have Monday available like tomorrow, if you want to do it tomorrow?' which is framed as a scheduling choice, not a direct ask for the business. Customer agrees to Wednesday, and rep confirms booking without ever asking 'Would you like our help with your move?'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. Rep states 'you will only be asked to make the payment once we completed the move' but does not mention rate-lock or guarantee that the estimate will not change.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Date (Wednesday October 7th), arrival window (8:30–9:00 AM), pickup address (110 county road 304 lot 21, Archeru Texas 78605, Shilo RV village noted), drop address (330 Golden Paint Trail, Liberty Hill TX 78642), email confirmation sent. Missing: phone number re-confirmed at booking, crew size not stated, specific notes about customer concerns not documented for the crew (generator fuel-disconnected detail was discussed but not explicitly noted as crew memo).

top_strength: Excellent logistics detail gathering — rep captured dimensions, special items (generator, patio tables with glass), parking details, and current/destination addresses comprehensively, laying a solid foundation for an accurate quote.
coaching_note: Section 5 (Two Promises) and Section 6 (final genuine concerns check) were entirely skipped — the On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage are load-bearing promises that differentiate Einstein and were never delivered, and the customer was not given a real final chance to surface remaining concerns before booking.
